provenance.treatment: retain source URL, revision/effective date, access status, byte count, and SHA-256; invalidate on change

coverage.treatment: record missing local displacement, baseline, price, and stable programme ID as deferred; do not infer absence

parameter.treatment: no n, m, d, mu, phi, annual effect, price, or aligned samples are supplied

structural.treatment: retain alternative pathway and comparator interpretations as qualitative scenario branches only

synthetic_sensitivity.treatment: use only clearly labelled Chapter 7 synthetic/public-context scenarios and sensitivity analyses; never promote as empirical

correlation_and_joint_uncertainty: not estimable from available public context; no independence assumption is permitted
calibration_policy: disabled until Atlas-approved same-programme packet and NHS displacement evidence are bound
authority: Atlas owner adjudication required before promotion
